messages:
Sam Wright: Quick pass please — new Figma for API keys page. Focus: create/rotate/revoke flows, permission affordances, and empty states. https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
Maria Chen: Love the overall. Two quick things: 1) 'Rotate' is buried under kebab, should be primary when key is active and you have perms. 2) Add a subtle inline hint in the row: 'Can rotate: Org Admin' so we don't require clicking into details.
Jess O'Neil: A11y: keyboard users need an easy way to reveal key (current show-secret button not reachable by Enter on row). Also ensure the revoke modal has role=\"dialog\" and focus trap. Error state for failed rotate needs aria-live=\"polite\".
Liam Patel: Microcopy: revoke warning is a bit soft — suggest: 'Revoking will immediately revoke access. This action is irreversible; to re-enable, create a new key.' Also propose an 'Undo' toast after revoke that gives a 30s rollback window if backend supports it.
Noah Rivera: Empty state copy nit: instead of 'Create an API key', use 'Create your first API key to get started' + a single-line example snippet to reduce friction. Secondary CTA: 'Learn about key scopes' linking to docs.
a11y-bot: Automated check: color contrast on danger button fails WCAG AA at 14px. Recommend adjusting color from #b22222 to #a11a1a or increasing font weight. Also flagged keyboard focus ring is 2px faint in dark mode.
Sam Wright: For the inline hint, can we do a small pill with grayed text 'Can rotate — Org Admin' as part of the metadata column? Mockup attached in figma frame 3.
Maria Chen: +1 but make sure it doesn't increase row height when there are multiple pills. Prefer single-line pill with ellipsis/truncate.
Jess O'Neil: For screen reader, pills should expose aria-label like 'Can rotate: Organization admin'. Also ensure the pill is navigable by tab but not announced as button if it's informational.
Liam Patel: On the 'reveal secret' UX — propose long-press copy on mobile and a 'Show' button on desktop. Also add a small account-level setting 'Allow show secret' that org admins can toggle (for compliance customers).
Noah Rivera: Also suggest adding an audit column 'Last used' to help users decide whether to revoke. Could be low priority but high value for security reviews.
Sam Wright: Quick example snippet for empty state to include: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
``` Keep it one-line and copy-friendly.
Maria Chen: We'll try an inline example and a small clipboard button. Make sure clipboard has proper accessible label.
Jess O'Neil: Accessibility action items: 1) Keyboard tests for show/reveal, 2) Modal role + focus trap audit, 3) Toast/Undo ARIA announcements. I'll add them to the PR checklist.
Liam Patel: Copy variants I'll draft: strong revoke warning, secondary explanatory line, and shorter CTA for bulk revoke. Will post A/B copy options.
Noah Rivera: I'll draft empty state copy and add a doc link for 'scopes' + recommended snippet variants for devs.
Sam Wright: Action items: Maria -> iterate row affordance and pill behavior; Jess -> a11y checklist for modals & show-secret; Liam -> copy variants and toast undo wording; Noah -> empty-state examples + CTA links. I'll update figma and create a short design ticket. Thanks :rocket:
Maria Chen: I'll drop updated frames by EOD.
Jess O'Neil: Will stub the a11y tests in the PR description.
Noah Rivera: Drafts incoming this afternoon.
Sam Wright: Ping me if you want a copy pair review. Thanks everyone!
